name: gamification-xp-emulator-tests
description: Proves the grantQuestXpIfEligible transaction pattern is safe under real concurrency against the Firestore emulator. The Dart fake_cloud_firestore package used for test/gamification/subscription_service_xp_test.dart does not serialize concurrent runTransaction() calls (its _DummyTransaction has no locking/retry), so it cannot demonstrate the race is actually closed - only the real Firestore engine (via this emulator) does.
